sources.version_or_commit: GitHub commit 698795ed19d8f1d8032f988e68123d39dd842413 (main HEAD observed at retrieval); commit date 2026-10-09T14:10:10Z
sources.locator: Mapping and Validation; Validations; edmRights normalization and validation; NARA section references in S02; Running ingests
sources.observed_operation: Pinned GitHub source view opened read-only; repository API commit metadata fetched read-only; no code was run.
sources.observed_behavior: Pipeline accepts API, file and OAI source categories, harvests, maps per-provider, validates, enriches/normalizes and exports. Rights variants are normalized then checked; errors/warnings are recorded. In one documented case invalid edm:rights plus dc:rights passes while invalid URI is omitted; invalid-only rights fails.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Documented required mapped fields include dataProvider, isShownAt, rights, title and originalId. Rights normalization rules include scheme/URI cleanup and logs warnings. Provider mappings are not reused across providers. This describes DPLA's pipeline only.
sources.applicability: Operational comparator for five different sources, per-collection mapping, original retention and update diagnostics; not a rule that the regional network should rewrite or decide source claims.

sources.observed_operation: Pinned GitHub source view and text excerpt inspected read-only; no pipeline or data was run.

sources.title: Rights Statements FAQ
sources.version_or_commit: FAQ unversioned; vocabulary statement URI form explicitly carries its own version, commonly /1.0/
sources.locator: General: what statements are and how they differ from CC licenses; Technical: URI formats and using /vocab/ URI
sources.observed_operation: Official search snippets returned the relevant FAQ text; direct open failed with HTTP 526/timeout in two attempts.
sources.observed_behavior: Retrieved snippet states the statements describe rights/reuse status and are not licenses; data should use the statement URI /vocab/[id]/[version]/ rather than page/data representation URLs.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: The exact FAQ page was not directly retrievable in this session; claims are limited to search text. A direct statement page such as Copyright Undetermined is available from the official domain.
sources.applicability: Supports distinction and URI modeling; do not present the statements as network-issued grants.

sources.title: Understanding the rights statements used by Europeana
sources.version_or_commit: Living Europeana rights guidance; page lists its current 14 accepted options
sources.locator: Sections 1-3: rights statements, Creative Commons public-domain tools and CC licenses
sources.observed_operation: Official Europeana PRO page opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: Page distinguishes CC0 dedication, Public Domain Mark, CC licenses and RightsStatements.org statements; says CC licenses are for in-copyright works and institution may apply only if it holds all rights.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Europeana's accepted set and Data Exchange Agreement apply to Europeana submissions, not automatically to the regional catalogue.
sources.applicability: Terminology distinction and cautious statement selection pattern; no legal conclusion for any object.

sources.title: How to select an accurate rights statement
sources.version_or_commit: Europeana guidance updated 2024-09-20
sources.locator: Section 1 on best efforts/organizational sharing policy; Section 3 on content vs digital object
sources.observed_operation: Official Europeana PRO page opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: Europeana requires its partners to provide one of its rights statements, expects best efforts for correctness, and says organizational sharing policy matters; its guidance discusses rights on content and digital objects.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Platform-specific requirements. Guidance encourages simple user-facing treatment but does not authorize the regional network to select or alter a partner's statement.
sources.applicability: Rights/access and owner routing context; maintain source scope and avoid importing Europeana rules as local policy.

sources.title: Europeana Data Model Definition v5.2.7
sources.version_or_commit: EDM Definition v5.2.7 (April 2016)
sources.locator: Section 3.2.32, p. 39: edm:rights; surrounding classes/obligation table
sources.observed_operation: Official versioned PDF opened and relevant surrounding section read.
sources.observed_behavior: Defines rights for digital objects; mandatory for ore:Aggregation; optional for edm:WebResource, at most one; allowed URI set is platform-defined. Nearby edm:type is a mandatory controlled term while original local type is also retained in dc:type.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Historical EDM 5.2.7 model only; version-specific obligation and namespace. Do not treat as the pilot's current schema.
sources.applicability: Demonstrates object/representation scope and separate original/mapped controlled terms.

sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 3.0
sources.version_or_commit: Presentation API 3.0.0; stable published 2020-06-03
sources.locator: Status; properties rights, requiredStatement, provider, seeAlso, rendering; responses/context/versioning
sources.observed_operation: Official formal specification opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: `rights` is an allowed URI for rights/license; `requiredStatement` is a visible localized text object; `provider` is structured; `seeAlso` identifies machine-readable related metadata and `rendering` an alternate human-consumable representation.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Clients may render `rights`; they must render requiredStatement; seeAlso clients may process; rendering should be rendered and target must directly display without interstitial page. Property use and resource types have stated constraints.
sources.applicability: Good target pattern if a collection uses IIIF; not evidence that a current collection publishes compliant v3 manifests.

sources.title: IIIF Presentation API 3.0 Change Log
sources.version_or_commit: Change log for 3.0.0, backwards-incompatible from 2.1.1
sources.observed_operation: Official change log opened and targeted entries inspected read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: `attribution` renamed `requiredStatement`; `license` renamed `rights`; provider structure and v3 context added. Reasons and related issue numbers are recorded.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Migration changes apply when moving a v2.1.1 manifest to v3; not every field is a mechanical rename because semantics and cardinality changed.
sources.applicability: Primary migration rule source for collection-specific IIIF manifests.

sources.title: IIIF API issue #1287: Rename attribution, change semantics to any text that must be rendered
sources.version_or_commit: Issue opened 2017-10-12; milestone Presentation 3.0 - RC1; closed per page
sources.locator: Issue description and proposal; compare adopted wording in S11/S10
sources.observed_operation: Public GitHub issue opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: Issue explains that client-generated `Attribution` labels can be confusing or legally problematic in museum context; a British Library example needed a publisher-defined rights/usage label.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Issue discussion is design history, not the normative rule; adopted rule is the released v3 spec/change log.
sources.applicability: Explains why old creator attribution and required visible statement must not be conflated in local migration.

sources.title: IIIF Cookbook recipe 0008: Rights statement
sources.version_or_commit: Cookbook recipe for Presentation API 3.0; non-normative example
sources.locator: Use Case and differences between `rights` and `requiredStatement`
sources.observed_operation: Official IIIF Cookbook page opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: Rights URIs are restricted to known license/right statement URIs or extensions; requiredStatement can hold arbitrary critical text and clients must render it while rights may or may not render visibly.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Cookbook is guidance; the formal property rules are in S10.
sources.applicability: Separate machine rights links from visible supplied text and optional help/credit UI.

sources.title: IIIF Cookbook recipe 0053: Linking to Structured Metadata
sources.version_or_commit: IIIF Cookbook; current recipe page, no discrete release tag
sources.locator: Differences between homepage, rendering and seeAlso
sources.observed_operation: Official IIIF Cookbook page opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: `seeAlso` can point to structured machine-readable metadata; `homepage` points to a page about the object; `rendering` is an alternate representation such as PDF/ePub.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Use each link only for its defined relation; the recipe does not establish the presence of any source endpoint.
sources.applicability: Optional source-attributed downloadable metadata record and help-link separation.

sources.observed_operation: Official specification opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: Defines service links/probe/access flow for controlled resources and response status, including alternate/substitute resources.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Access-control workflow applies to resource retrieval and is not a rights-status or reuse-license determination.
sources.applicability: Separate collection access conditions from reuse statement display if IIIF access controls are present.

sources.title: W3C SKOS Simple Knowledge Organization System Reference
sources.version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation 2009-08-18
sources.locator: Sections 10.1 and 10.6.3: mapping properties and transitivity; section 10.6.8 distinction from owl:sameAs
sources.observed_operation: Official W3C Recommendation opened and relevant sections inspected.
sources.observed_behavior: SKOS distinguishes exact, close, broad, narrow and related mappings across concept schemes; only exactMatch is declared transitive; closeMatch is non-transitive to avoid compounded errors.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Mapping links apply between SKOS concepts; not plain strings. Use precise relation semantics rather than identity assertions.
sources.applicability: Controlled-term mapping rule for heterogeneous source vocabularies.

sources.title: Getty AAT Editorial Guidelines: General Information
sources.version_or_commit: Living editorial guideline page; no stable numeric edition shown on this section
sources.locator: 1.1.1.3 Structure of Data; facets/hierarchies; concept warrant; 3.3 Terms cross-reference
sources.observed_operation: Official Getty Research Institute guideline opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: AAT concept records have unique numeric IDs, terms, relations, hierarchy, sources and notes. The guideline distinguishes a concept from a mere text string and supports keeping indexing terms separate from free-text display.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: AAT is a domain vocabulary for generic art/architecture concepts; it excludes people/place names and certain named subjects handled by other Getty vocabularies.
sources.applicability: Analogy for governed vocabularies with persistent IDs and evidence, not a universal vocabulary requirement.

sources.title: Getty Vocabularies and Linked Open Data
sources.version_or_commit: Getty presentation labeled May 2023
sources.locator: Pages 27-30: merged records, contributors, sources and revision history; pages 56-60: linked data, persistent IDs and attribution
sources.observed_operation: Official Getty PDF opened read-only; page text inspected.
sources.observed_behavior: Merged vocabulary records maintain contributors and sources; page 30 diagram identifies editor, action and date of action; Getty vocabularies expose stable linked-data records and attribution guidance.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Getty-specific editorial governance and ODC-By conditions; do not conflate Getty vocabulary data reuse with rights in collection images.
sources.applicability: Analogous controlled-vocabulary/provenance model: retain contributor/source/revision alongside a normalized concept.

sources.title: W3C PROV-O: The PROV Ontology
sources.version_or_commit: W3C Recommendation 2013-04-30
sources.locator: Starting-point properties; wasDerivedFrom; wasGeneratedBy; used; wasAssociatedWith; qualified usage/generation patterns
sources.observed_operation: Official W3C Recommendation opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: PROV-O links entities, transformation activities, responsible agents and qualified usage/generation/derivation; it can describe which source/entity a new record was derived from and which actor/rule generated it.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Ontology provides vocabulary, not an automatic provenance log or application workflow.
sources.applicability: Optional formal model for recording collection source, mapper/ruleset, time and derived field history.

sources.title: Rights Statements: Copyright Undetermined
sources.version_or_commit: RightsStatements.org vocabulary statement UND/1.0
sources.locator: Statement definition, Notices, disclaimer and URI for this statement
sources.observed_operation: Official statement page opened read-only.
sources.observed_behavior: Organization reviewed status but could not make a conclusive determination; statement says it is not a license and disclaims accuracy warranties while pointing users to provider.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: UND applies to a reviewed but unresolved status; it does not claim that the network has reviewed the item or determine legally permitted use.
sources.applicability: Keep distinct from no statement and from Copyright Not Evaluated; only display if supplied by the responsible collection registrar.

sources.title: Rights Statements: Copyright Not Evaluated
sources.version_or_commit: RightsStatements.org vocabulary statement CNE/1.0
sources.locator: Statement definition and URI for this statement
sources.observed_operation: Official search-result excerpt read; direct open returned HTTP 526.
sources.observed_behavior: Official result states the making-available organization has not evaluated copyright and related-rights status; the statement URI is http://rightsstatements.org/vocab/CNE/1.0/.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: CNE means the providing organization has not evaluated status; it is not equivalent to UND, no supplied statement, or a public-domain claim.
sources.applicability: Semantic example only; show it only when the collection registrar actually supplies it.

sources.title: Omeka S CSV Import module release page
sources.version_or_commit: Module release listing: CSV Import 2.6.2, released 2024-10-22, minimum Omeka S ^4.0.0
sources.locator: Module description and release compatibility table
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka module page retrieved through the official-site search result; page was not run or installed.
sources.observed_behavior: Imports/updates items, item sets, media and users from CSV, TSV or ODS; rows map to entities; additional modules may add types.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: ODS import depends on PHP zip and xml extensions. Listed minimum Omeka version is ^4.0.0; compatibility must be rechecked against any selected deployment and module release.
sources.applicability: A configurable import step for an Omeka S pilot, not evidence that it natively aggregates five independent source feeds or supplies source-aware reconciliation.

sources.title: Omeka S CSV Import user manual
sources.version_or_commit: Living manual; module options correspond to the CSV Import 2.x workflow; deployment version not selected
sources.locator: Permissions and UTF-8 preparation; Advanced Settings actions; identifier matching; Past Imports and Undo
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka user manual content retrieved through the official-site search result; no install or import was performed.
sources.observed_behavior: Create is default. Append, Revise, Update, Replace and Delete support identified records. Revise leaves values when cells are empty; Update replaces even on empty cells; Replace removes all properties before repopulating; Delete removes matching resources. Past Imports shows action, details/log, results/status/owner and has an Undo control.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Module is available to Global Administrator and Supervisor; import requires working PHP background jobs and UTF-8 source. Matching uses exact value of the selected property; if more than one record matches, the oldest is selected. The manual labels several operations “Cannot be undone” and also documents an Undo control; resolve that apparent scope/operation tension on the selected version before any pilot write.
sources.applicability: Concrete update/delete and audit behaviors to include in an isolated fixture test; do not assume empty-field or duplicate-ID semantics are suitable for five collection feeds.

sources.title: Omeka S Rights Statements module release page
sources.version_or_commit: Module 1.2.1, released 2023-01-19, listed for Omeka S ^3.0.0 || ^4.0.0
sources.locator: Module description, Rights Statement data type, and compatibility table
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka module page retrieved through the official-site search result; no module was installed or exercised.
sources.observed_behavior: Adds a Rights Statement data type to a property in a resource template; its dropdown presents 11 RightsStatements.org statements and applies both a human-readable name and linked-data URI.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Requires compatible installed module and a template using that data type. The page lists only 11 statements and does not establish that this release tracks all currently published or partner-accepted statement URIs.
sources.applicability: Possible data-entry aid, not a binary permission mapper or complete network-wide decision. Compare current statement coverage and preservation behavior before selection.

sources.title: Omeka S Value Suggest user manual
sources.version_or_commit: Living user manual; module release is not selected for this study
sources.locator: RightsStatements.org and Creative Commons vocabulary list; suggestion behavior; batch conversion of existing values
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka user manual content retrieved through the official-site search result; no module was installed or exercised.
sources.observed_behavior: Provides suggestions from RightsStatements.org and Creative Commons among other vocabularies, but users may ignore suggestions and type text. Batch conversion can convert matching strings/URIs; the manual says converted labels may remain empty or source labels may be preserved, rather than importing the vocabulary-provided structured label.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Suggestions are assigned through resource templates; conversion requires matching and user action. The module cannot require controlled-vocabulary choices. Validate exact source-value and label preservation before batch conversion.
sources.applicability: Evidence that Omeka suggestions do not alone enforce complete controlled input; preserve raw text and URI separately and do not treat autocomplete as a rights-validation gate.

sources.title: Omeka S OAI-PMH Repository module page
sources.version_or_commit: Module 3.4.14, released 2026-10-05, minimum Omeka S ^4.0.0
sources.locator: Module purpose; global/site endpoints; namespace; formats and file exposure defaults; TODO list
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka module page content retrieved through the official-site search result; no repository endpoint was configured or harvested.
sources.observed_behavior: Publishes Omeka items, item sets and media through OAI-PMH 2.0; offers a global endpoint and optional per-site endpoints, crosswalks and formats. `oai_dc` is required; `simple_xml` can expose all vocabulary values. Media exposure defaults false; deletion support is explicitly listed as TODO.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Requires installation of the Common module and compatible Omeka S. Namespace should be a registered domain; if the server domain cannot be detected, the default `default.must.change` is intentionally unsuitable. File links/IIIF manifests appear only when media exposure is enabled and configured.
sources.applicability: Optional publishing path for a source-attributed metadata record; OAI output, crosswalk, endpoint and tombstone/delete behavior must be tested before choosing it as a feed. It is a repository/publisher, not an inbound harvester.

sources.title: Omeka S REST API developer documentation
sources.version_or_commit: Living developer documentation; non-JSON-LD response formats documented from Omeka S 4.1.0
sources.locator: Endpoint and response/request formats; authentication and public resource access
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka developer documentation retrieved through the official-site search result; no API endpoint or credentials were used.
sources.observed_behavior: REST API is under `/api`; JSON-LD is the default response format. From 4.1.0, clients may request listed alternate formats. Anonymous read is allowed for public resources; private data and actions require authentication.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Write requests require authenticated API keys. Payloads should be JSON-LD and API-required structures may be narrower than arbitrary valid JSON-LD.
sources.applicability: Potential read/export/import integration path; verify pagination, fields, access exposure and version-specific JSON-LD behavior in a safe fixture before relying on it.

sources.title: Omeka S Access module page
sources.version_or_commit: Module page lists release 3.4.48; current deployment compatibility was not selected
sources.locator: Description, independent visibility/access/embargo rules, file and resource-notice behavior
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka module page content retrieved through the official-site search result; no module was installed or exercised.
sources.observed_behavior: Adds file-access rules and embargo handling distinct from resource visibility. Public/private visibility, file access, and embargo are independent; an access restriction applies to files and does not hide the resource notice.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Behavior requires the module and server rewrite/access configuration; exposure can vary by resource, media, role, embargo and inherited collection/item settings. Public metadata presence does not imply public file access.
sources.applicability: Supports modeling local file/access policy separately from reuse statement. A pilot must not retrieve or scrape restricted files and must test metadata notice versus media visibility.

sources.title: Omeka S Custom Vocab user manual
sources.version_or_commit: Living user manual; module release is not selected for this study
sources.locator: URI vocabularies with labels; duplicate URI behavior; converting existing values
sources.observed_operation: Official Omeka user manual content retrieved through the official-site search result; no module was installed or exercised.
sources.observed_behavior: A custom URI vocabulary can pair URIs with labels; duplicate URI entries with different labels collapse to the final entry. Conversion to a custom vocabulary requires exact URI or text matching; converting a URI+label may replace the original label.
sources.governing_condition_default_exception: Applies only to installed module vocabularies and template/data-type conversions; existing records are not automatically normalized. Preserve source values before conversion.
sources.applicability: Potential local mapping aid, with a documented label-loss risk. It does not substitute for external, versioned SKOS mapping provenance.
